about: Human role-breadth annotations for the role-breadth experiment (docs/role-breadth-fit-experiment.md). Each label describes how concentrated the job's own work is: broad, focused, deep_specialist, unclear; out_of_scope marks postings the deterministic filter let through that are not software-engineering IC work (excluded from metrics). Not a candidate fit. Not read by production code.
annotator: one annotator (Claude), from exactly the job-only text breadth_probe dumps, after the pre-registration (5864c38) and before any breadth logic existed.

conventions.also: another acceptable label for a borderline job; strict agreement uses breadth alone
conventions.family: breadth is judged within the role family the work belongs to (security work against security, platform work against platform)
